evaluator: Claude Sonnet 5.5, single judge, AI-assessed, dev entities only (120 sampled from the 100 development papers' verified entities)
judgement_basis: entity name, entity type, candidate page title and first sentence of its lead

guards: not a disambiguation or list page
entity name in page title or lead
entity name and page title match (squashed, parenthetical removed)

note: small sample; test-set linking accuracy is measured in E4 and may differ. Recall of existing pages is low by design (precision over recall).
judgement_note: entity 118 was judged on the accepted page ('Combinatorial search'), not the top-scored page; its per-entity row reflects the top-scored page
